msg: warning: Variable mod is freed multiple times!
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): 6e2b75740be.c (Linux module loader). 'Variable mod is freed multiple times!' at line 63, when def(MODULE_UNLOAD) AND def(SMP). After the while loop at line 48, 'mod = module_core(mod)' makes mod alias the module_core allocation. At line 60, free(module_core(mod)) frees that allocation. At line 63, free(refptr(mod)) dereferences the now-freed mod pointer — use-after-free/double-free on the aliased region. The //ERROR comment at line 63 confirms this is the known vbdb bug (double-free/use-after-free on mod). CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: both MODULE_UNLOAD=true and SMP=true are required to compile lines 30-35 (refptr allocation) and line 63 (refptr free).
